applicabilityBasis.summary: USDx targets a dollar value but direct redemption is an approved-account signed-order exchange for supported digital-asset collateral. Axis terms disclaim a guaranteed value and guaranteed redemption availability. GENIUS section 2(22) separately requires a fixed monetary-value repayment obligation, excluding a digital asset merely denominated in fixed monetary value. These public terms do not settle USDx's U.S. legal category; synthetic backing and U.S.-person restrictions alone do not establish a statutory exclusion.

genius.notes: Coordinate Origin Limited is preserved as the BVI issuance/redemption entity named in current terms, distinct from Singapore platform operator Coordinate Labs Pte. Ltd. USDx is marketed as a dollar-linked settlement asset, but collateral exchange through approved signed orders and disclaimed guaranteed redemption do not settle whether an issuer is obligated to repay fixed monetary value under GENIUS. U.S.-person restrictions do not establish a statutory exclusion. The dated public-source review found no exact GENIUS approval, official application, state qualification or registered foreign exception; issuerPathway and foreignExceptionStatus remain unknown. Current transparency reserves are disclosed, but the live Accountable feed/security audits are not monthly statutory financial attestations or authorization. EU/EEA enhanced-due-diligence applications prevent a territorial MiCA out-of-scope inference; no named NCA/venue non-compliance decision was located, so parent MiCA remains unable to verify rather than importing the Ethena precedent. GENIUS issuance/sale rules remain pre-effective with Treasury expecting January 18, 2027.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: No public GENIUS PPSI approval, state-qualified approval, official PPSI application or registered foreign exception naming Coordinate Origin Limited / Axis USDx was located in the listed sources. This is a dated public-evidence finding, not proof that no private or unindexed application exists. Bank-charter and legacy licensing tables are not comprehensive GENIUS registers; proposed rules and SCRC procedural forms do not authorize an issuer.
